parts.name: body_a16n126
sources: The body of the A-16N126: 12 by 16 by 6 in (Kele: Small Type 1 Enclosure, A1SM, 16.00x12.00x6.00, steel, gray); steel of 16 gauge (as the A12N128, Lumen); the lips and the holes by eye.

parts.name: butt_hinge_a16n126_fixed_leaf
sources: A butt hinge of steel of 1 1/2 in, its leaves 0.45 in, inside the flange of the cover (1/2 in): by eye.

parts.name: butt_hinge_a16n126_moving_leaf
sources: A butt hinge of steel of 1 1/2 in, its leaves 0.45 in, inside the flange of the cover (1/2 in): by eye.

parts.name: cover_a16n126
sources: The cover of the A-16N126: a pan of steel of 16 gauge on butt hinges (Kele: removable doors with butt hinges); its flanges by eye.
